condition: When a single scan_delta LazyFrame built from a path string is reused in several branches of a plan (e.g. concat), the Delta table is opened and its transaction log re-read several times, and the count varies from run to run. On object storage this multiplies the requests sent.
workaround: Open the table once with deltalake.DeltaTable(path) and pass that object to pl.scan_delta instead of passing the path.
